about: The decomposition a planner would naturally arrive at for bench/fixture-medium/brief.md: one issue per row, `needs` the issues that must land first. It is NOT given to any arm; test/test_bench_medium.py checks that its size (6-10), shape (acyclic, at least 2 independent issues at one depth) and the two subsystems stay what the fixture claims.

subsystems.shelves: the catalogue, the stock movements, what is low
subsystems.orders: prices, discounts, tax, shipping what is in stock, invoices, a report

issues.title: Project skeleton: packaging, errors, money and date helpers, ledger-style file reading
Movements parser, stock rule (never below zero), stock_levels
Shelves CLI: stock, low, history, receive, ship, --json, exit statuses
Pricing: volume discount, order discount shared by largest remainder, tax per line, price_order
fulfil: what the shelves can cover, earlier shipments, later movements
